question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Immense**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Immense**" means extremely large or great in degree. (डिग्री में बहुत बड़ा या महान)
 
• The word fits the context of the sentence, suggesting that the blank should be filled with a word indicating a high degree of something.
 
 
• **For example**: *The task of cleaning up after the party was immense, with piles of dishes and trash to be taken care of.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Partial **means of or relating to a part rather than the whole. (आंशिक)
 
• **Complete **means finished or whole. (समाप्त या संपूर्ण)
 
• **Total **means complete or absolute. (पूर्ण या निरपेक्ष)
